name: LastFM Album Metadata (22k Entries)
description: Album-level metadata retrieved from Last.fm using the Last.fm API. The API was queried using album names from the MusicBrainz dataset as query strings. The original retrieval contains over 85,000 entities. A reduced version contains around 22,000 entries and provides album name and artist, as well as tracklists including track title, duration, and position on the album. Additional fields present in the CSV include the Last.fm URL for the album and popularity indicators returned by the API (listeners and playcount).
